plot: At midnight in the freezer the lonely ghost Frostbite freezes Lolly mid-sentence; Zeek's heater and Bup's rubbing plan fail, Zeek realizes only an inner warmth will thaw her, Pim's panicky joke makes Frostbite laugh and Lolly melts, she offers him weekly tea instead, and Frostbite warns that the toaster has joined Mr. Pot.

beats.say: Just grabbing frozen berries for my icing. In and out. What could possibly go—
Lolly? LOLLY! She stopped in the middle of a word! Her mouth is still open!
Shhh... she stays now... forever... and ever... cold...
Frostbite! Let her go right now, you walking ice cube!
Midnight, inside the freezer. At sunrise the humans open the door, and anything still in here gets packed away for winter.
Fascinating. A full-body frost shell. Two centimeters thick. Possibly three.
Stop measuring her and UN-freeze her! Her icing is turning into a popsicle!
Behold. The Heat-o-Matic Nine Thousand. It turns one battery into a tiny pocket sun.
Tiny suns... have a way of exploding.
Nonsense. Pressing the button in three... two...
It made one warm bubble. ONE! And now the whole freezer smells like burnt socks.
Warm things... always fail... in my house. Hee... hee...
Plan B. Friction makes heat. Everybody grab a point of the star and rub!
Four friends. One frozen star cookie. Zero dignity.
My hands are sticking to her! Now I'M freezing! Tell my mom I was brave!
You were not brave. You were screaming the whole time.
Wait. Why only Lolly? Frostbite had all five of us right here. He picked her.
Maybe pink is his favorite color?
That is not a joke, Bup. That is a clue.
Frostbite. Of all of us. Why her?
Every night... she opens my door... and says... goodnight, Frosty.
Nobody else talks to me. If she stays... I always have a goodnight.
Oh no. That is the saddest thing a ghost has ever said out loud.
Lonely things hold on too tight. I know.
My calculations were wrong. Outside heat won't melt this. She needs warmth from the inside.
Like soup? I can make soup. Mostly I can make a mess that looks like soup.
Like laughter. A real laugh is warm. Pim, you are the funniest when you panic.
I am NOT funny when I panic! ...Wait. Am I?
Knock knock! No wait, ghosts walk through doors. Okay. Why did the ice cube cross the road?
...I do not know. Why did the ice cube cross the road?
Because it was too COOL to stay! Get it? Cool? Please laugh, I can't feel my toes!
Hoo... hoo hoo... HA HA HA HA!
—WRONG! Who froze me?! I was in the middle of a SENTENCE!
Frosty. You do not freeze your friends. You ASK them to stay for tea.
Friends? You would drink tea... with me?
Iced tea, obviously. Every Tuesday. Goodnight included.
Great. Everybody out before sunrise. Move, move, move!
Wait... one warning. The big black pot came here last night. He asked me to keep you cold.
Mr. Pot. He is collecting helpers. One appliance at a time.
I said no. But the toaster... the toaster said yes.
The TOASTER said yes?! Nope. Goodbye. I'm fainting.

long.title: Lolly Got FROZEN Mid-Sentence?! 🥶
long.description: Lolly went into the freezer for berries and the ghost Frostbite froze her in the middle of a word. Zeek has until sunrise to thaw her out... and his invention smells like burnt socks. What would YOU have tried? 👇 #animation #doughbros #horrorcomedy
